general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Full dataset list for reference cohort: Pre-training: TractoInferno dataset (198 participants from 6 sites with single-shell dMRI, publicly available). Fine-tuning and clinical application: NIMHANS dataset (302 participants from India, 2 scanners: Philips 3T Ingenia n=110, Siemens 3T Skyra n=192). Model architecture details: ConvVAE with asymmetric architecture (4-layer encoder, 3-layer decoder), latent dimension 64, depthwise separable convolution, 454,742 trainable parameters. Training: Pre-training 29,000 steps with batch size 512 on TractoInferno; fine-tuning 5,000 steps on 50 NIMHANS CN (stratified by sex and scanner). Tractography details: 30 WM bundles segmented using DIPY RecoBundles; each streamline resampled to 128 equidistant points with 5 features (x, y, z, FA, MD); each bundle divided into 100 along-tract segments for analysis. Notable methodological innovation: First tractometry study to jointly model macro- and micro-structure using deep generative model; transfer learning from multi-site pre-training to new site demonstrates cross-domain generalizability; may help distinguish true microstructural changes from partial volume effects. Source publication: bioRxiv preprint posted February 6, 2024 (not peer-reviewed). The study provides detailed comparison with BUAN tractometry pipeline, showing both convergent findings (MD abnormalities) and divergent findings (FA differences in some tracts may reflect macrostructural rather than microstructural changes when geometry is accounted for). ADNI is mentioned in the context of prior work and comparison of findings, but ADNI data is not used in this study.
